description: This file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawNodeStorage' that provides static methods for constructing file URLs within specific application support and cache directories, tailored for session-based subdirectories related to 'canvas' and 'canvas-snapshots'.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the application's support directory, appending 'OpenClaw'. Throws an error if the directory is unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas' directory within the app support directory, scoped by a session key which defaults to 'main' if empty.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the caches directory, appending 'OpenClaw'. Throws an error if the directory is unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas-snapshots' directory within caches, scoped by a session key which defaults to 'main' if empty.
